ai_weight_rule: 1 if p_los >= threshold else floor + (1-floor)*p_los/threshold; majority-NLOS keeps predicted-NLOS anchors at the floor weight instead of falling back
final_weight: ai_weight (replaces the statistical weight; additive coupling)
selection_rule: no >+0.5% relative regression with a bootstrap interval entirely above zero in any scenario x anchor-count slice or anchor count; then largest mean paired improvement over the current policy on solvable mixed-fault, majority-NLOS and all-NLOS frames; then lowest fallback rate; then hard before soft and fixed grid order

range_correction.formula: observed_range - scale*p_nlos*predicted_bias, applied only when p_nlos > min_p_nlos

ablation_evidence.finding: anchor-count scaling had no effect (<=0.002 m); the tighter NLOS gate regressed RMSE by +0.066 m [+0.025,+0.107]; both removed.
